name: Kallow DigitEase Articulated Trouser
description: Cut specifically for digitigrade legs, these trousers have an elongated lower leg with a sharply angled hem that sits flush against a raised heel stance. The knee joint is set high and the calf panel is dramatically tapered to follow the reverse-bend anatomy. Available in a warm oat canvas. They look strange on a standard body; on a digitigrade wearer, they look right.
functionality: Digitigrade-specific cut with articulated knee placement and angled hem; not functional on standard bipedal anatomy
what_it_says: You invested in clothes that actually fit you, which takes either money or self-respect — probably both.
story_hooks: A tailor in Tier 2 makes near-identical knockoffs but slightly wrong — the knee joint is 2cm off and causes joint pain after a full shift.
The only person in a room wearing these correctly-fitted trousers stands out immediately as someone who can afford to care.

physical_description.visual_profile: A distinctly non-human silhouette that transforms a digitigrade wearer into a sleek, predatory figure. The high knee break and dramatically tapered calf create an inverted triangle from hip to ankle, emphasizing the reverse-bend leg geometry. On standard bipeds, deeply unsettling; on augmented digitigrade frames, architecturally perfect.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered compression through the thigh, with a sharp taper that begins mid-calf and extends to a geometrically calculated hem angled to match a raised heel stance (approximately 35-40 degree forward lean). The knee joint sits 2-3 inches higher than standard trouser proportions.
physical_description.primary_material: Warm oat canvas—a durable, slightly nubby synthetic-natural blend with subtle color variation that reads as professional-grade workwear
physical_description.texture: Firmly woven with minimal stretch; the surface has a matte finish with slight directional nap. Seams are reinforced with contrast stitching visible at stress points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Warm oat beige with subtle tonal variation; charcoal reinforcement stitching at seams and angle points; minimal branding
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap fly with hidden retention strap; waistband tension-lock with friction fit (no traditional belt loops)
distinctive_features: Anatomically contoured calf panel that mirrors reverse-bend leg structure
High knee articulation point with reinforced gusset
Angled hem precisely cut to sit flush against digitigrade heel positioning
Integrated micro-adhesive strip at inner calf for non-slip stance
Hidden access panel at outer thigh for augmentation maintenance
Kallow brand emboss (small, metallic) at rear waistband
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 specialized augmentation wear; expensive enough to signal invested body modification, accessible to working-class augmented labor
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by digitigrade-augmented warehouse workers, courier runners, combat-frame operatives, and corporate security with leg mods. Signals accepted transhumanism and practical augmentation investment. Rarely seen on unmodified bodies.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in with visible creasing at knee articulation and heel point; minor fraying at hem from repeated stance-release cycles; possible scuff marks from industrial environments
